title: 第259章 盖棺定论第258章 信任的基础
content_zh:
“庄院主于我苍龙一族有引路塑道之恩情，今日你既然拿出了此物，我等便看在庄院主的情面上，暂且不对杨氏之人动手。”
苍龙族大尊者自那道真玄上收回了目光，随后又重新落在了夜沉锋和杨灵睿身上：“但今日之事不可能就此作罢，你们必须要给我们苍龙族一个交代，不然，就算是庄院主亲至，我们这几把老骨头就是拼了命，也定要讨回一份说法！”
这老龙说话的语气听起来很严厉，实则却已经是放低姿态服了软，他能表现出这样的态度来，愿意听几人解释，那接下来也就好办了。
夜沉锋闻言也是收起手中长剑，展颜一笑：“请诸位前辈放心，我等此番既然来到了苍龙族地，定然会给你们一个满意的答复！”
紧接着，便是由杨灵睿现身说法，将神武此前在瓮中道场内所说的那个故事，与禁地中的所有苍龙族高层修士们又从头至尾讲述了一遍。
起初，苍龙族的这些高层们在听闻此事的时候，面上也是难免会有几分狐疑之色，有些不太相信杨灵睿的这份说法。
但随着故事内容的不断深入，一点点触及到了他们所得到的仙宝和仙法，这些苍龙族修士们的面色便明显有了变化。
随后在杨灵睿循循善诱的引导之下，在场的四位苍龙族老祖，以及一众真意高层，便都开始按照他讲述的方法，对自己的身魂进行内视探查。
结果这不看不要紧，一看可真是给他们吓了一大跳。
“仙宝在试图争夺我的神魂主导权？为什么我之前全然没有发现！”
“我的寿元竟然无端折损了八年，是从什么时候开始的！”
“此等手段，当真歹毒！”
“那仙宝，不！那邪物能惑人心神，一旦有所接触后，便会在不经意间麻痹我等的感知，若非今日灵睿小友提醒，就这么继续修炼下去，恐怕会酿成大祸！”
“我等只是修炼了基础法诀，尚不曾深入，都已经有如此影响，那苍屿和苍寻他们，岂不是已经...”
当发现那份所谓的仙宝与仙法之力，皆是在他们不曾察觉的时候，便侵蚀着自己的神魂、蚕食着自己的寿元，这些苍龙族修士便都是感到脊背发凉，生出了一份后怕之意。
再一想到带回邪法的两位族中天骄，心中便更是忧惧万分。
那苍龙族大尊者赶忙褪去龙身显化人形，与杨灵睿拱手执礼道：“方才是我等受了那邪法蛊惑，不曾明辨是非，诸多无礼之处，还望命官多多包涵。”
与方才那般盛气凌人的态度截然相反，现在的苍龙族大尊者，甚至连对杨灵睿的称呼都做了改变，不再直呼其名讳，而是唤了那命官的名号。
旁观的那些真意境苍龙修士，或许还无法真正理解杨灵睿所修杀道之法的厉害之处，更无法体会到那道断业判令之中的蕴藏着何等伟力。
可四名苍龙族老祖，方才却是真真切切的体验了一把被生生剥离因果的体验。

他们都是已经度过了悟死参玄大劫的尊者之身，但即便如此，在这道判令降下之时，他们依旧感受到了一份仿若苍天压顶、大道临头的感觉。
那份感受并非是面对强者之时的恐惧与压迫，也并非是遇到危险之时的慌乱与无措，而是一种本该如此、就当如此，不可违逆的庄严肃穆之感。
修行到了他们这种地步，自是能够通过这种非凡的感受来推演其背后的实质。
他们知晓论及现在的修为战力，杨灵睿或许还远远比不得自己，可以他所展现的天资，未来定然能够走到与自己并肩，甚至超越的地步。
content_en:
"The master of the village is kind to our Canglong clan for guiding and shaping the road. Since you took out this thing today, we will consider the favor of the master of the village and not take action against the Yang family for the time being."
The Great Master of the Canglong Clan withdrew his gaze from the True Mystery, and then fell on Ye Chenfeng and Yang Lingrui again: "But today's matter cannot be settled here. You must give us Canglong Clan an explanation. Otherwise, even if the master of the village comes in person, we old bones will fight for our lives to get an explanation!"
The old dragon's tone of voice sounded harsh, but in fact he had already lowered his attitude and surrendered. If he could show such an attitude and be willing to listen to a few people's explanations, then the next step would be easy.
Hearing this, Ye Chenfeng also put away the sword in his hand and smiled: "Seniors, please rest assured, since I have come to the Canglong Clan this time, I will definitely give you a satisfactory answer!"
Immediately afterwards, Yang Lingrui appeared and told the story that Shenwu had told in the Wengzhong Dojo from beginning to end to all the senior Canglong Clan monks in the forbidden area.
At first, when the senior officials of the Canglong Clan heard about this matter, their faces were inevitably a little suspicious, and some did not quite believe Yang Lingrui's statement.
But as the content of the story continued to deepen, and the fairy treasures and magic methods they obtained were touched upon little by little, the expressions of these Canglong monks changed obviously.
Then, under the guidance of Yang Lingrui, the four ancestors of the Canglong clan and a group of Zhenyi senior officials present began to conduct inward inspections of their bodies and souls according to the method he described.
It didn't matter if they didn't see it. They were really shocked when they saw it.
"Is the Immortal Treasure trying to compete for the dominance of my soul? Why didn't I notice it before?"
"My longevity has been reduced for eight years for no reason. When did it start!"
"Such methods are really vicious!"
"That fairy treasure, no! That evil thing can confuse people's minds. Once it comes into contact, it will inadvertently paralyze our perception. If little friend Lingrui hadn't reminded me today, if we continued to practice like this, I'm afraid it would have caused a catastrophe!"
"We have only practiced the basic techniques and have not gone into depth yet, but we have already had such an impact. Then Cang Yu and Cang Xun, haven't they already..."
When they discovered that the power of the so-called immortal treasures and immortal spells were eroding their souls and consuming their longevity without their noticing, these Canglong monks all felt chills running down their spines and felt a sense of fear.
When I think of the two geniuses from the clan who brought back the evil magic, I feel even more worried.
The great lord of the Canglong Clan quickly shed his dragon body and took on the human form. He cupped his hands with Yang Lingrui and said in salute, "It's just now that we were bewitched by that evil method. We didn't know right from wrong. We have done so many rude things. I hope your magistrate will forgive me."
Contrary to the domineering attitude just now, the current Great Master of the Canglong Clan even changed his name to Yang Lingrui. He no longer called him by his first name, but called the official by his name.
The True Illusion Canglong cultivators watching on the sidelines may not be able to truly understand the power of Yang Lingrui's method of killing, let alone the great power contained in the decree to end karma.
But the four ancestors of the Canglong clan had just experienced the experience of being stripped of their cause and effect.
They were all sages who had gone through the Great Tribulation of Enlightenment and Death, but even so, when the decree came down, they still felt as if the sky was pressing down and the great road was approaching.
That feeling is not the fear and oppression when facing a strong person, nor is it the panic and helplessness when encountering danger, but a solemn and solemn feeling that it should be this way, this is the way it should be, and it is irreversible.
After practicing to their level, they can naturally deduce through this extraordinary feeling.Act out the essence behind it.
They knew that in terms of current cultivation and combat power, Yang Lingrui might still be far behind them, but with the talent he had shown, he would definitely be able to equal or even surpass them in the future.
